transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Honestly, I'm mainly here because... well, HR at work and my sister keep saying I've gotten way too thin. I don't really see it as a problem, though. From my side, I just see that my suits fit a lot sharper for my client meetings now. I mean, yeah, my weight has kept dropping since the divorce, but they're the ones making a big deal out of it and insisting I come talk to someone.
Have you been actively trying to lose weight?

Yeah, I suppose I am. I just keep a pretty tight handle on what I eat now. Most days I just stick to black coffee in the morning, and then maybe I'll grab a protein bar between my sales calls. 

At night, I'll do something small... like just some grilled chicken, but no rice or anything heavy with it. It's just that, well, once I sit down and actually start eating a full meal, it feels like I've just messed up the whole day. So I prefer to keep it strict.
How would you feel if you were to gain weight?

Honestly, it would really bother me. If I step on the scale and it's even a pound higher—like after a client dinner or, you know, a weekend out in Miami—I get this immediate panic. It just feels like I'm completely losing control of things. When I see that number go up, I just start planning exactly how I'm going to cut back the next day to fix it.
How much do you currently weigh?
I'm currently at 122 pounds. I know it sounds a little low for a guy my height, but like I said, I feel like I look fine.
Could you tell me how tall you are?
Have you noticed any changes in your sex drive or interest in sex lately?
Not really, no. I haven't noticed any changes there. Everything seems pretty normal in that department, honestly.
